items.t: "엔비디아의 진짜 해자 CUDA에 도전"…아마존,AI칩 소프트웨어 공개
items.fullText: 반도체인사이트 "엔비디아의 진짜 해자 CUDA에 도전"…아마존,AI칩 소프트웨어 공개 입력 2026.10.20 00:11 수정 2026.10.20 00:11 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김정아 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 아마존이 자사 AI 칩 '트레이니엄'에서 파이토치 코드를 손쉽게 실행할 수 있는 소프트웨어 '토치 뉴런'을 공개하며 엔비디아의 CUDA 독점 생태계에 도전장을 내밀었다. 아마존, CUDA생태계에 도전하는 소프트웨어 출시 아마존 트레이니엄칩으로 전환비용 낮추는 소프트웨어 사진=REUTERS 아마존닷컴은 자사의 맞춤형 인공지능(AI) 칩에서 널리 사용되는 AI 코딩 언어로 작성된 코드를 그대로 실행할 수 있는 소프트웨어를 공개할 계획이다. 이는 CUDA 소프트웨어를 통해 AI칩 컴퓨팅 생태계를 지배해온 엔비디아에 대해 소프트웨어 부문에서도 도전하는 시도로 해석된다. 엔비디아는 그래픽처리장치(GPU)의 연산 성능뿐만이 아니라 CUDA 소프트웨어를 통해 AI개발자들을 엔비디아에 묶어두는 효과를 누리고 있다. 19일(현지시간) 로이터에 따르면, 아마존은 ‘토치 뉴런’이라는 자체 개발 소프트웨어를 사용하면 AI개발자들이 주로 사용하는 파이토치 언어로 작성된 코드를 이 회사의 트레이니엄 칩에서 한 번의 설정 변경만으로 실행할 수 있다고 밝혔다. 이 소프트웨어는 이 날 실리콘밸리에서 열리는 개발자 컨퍼런스에서 발표되며 무료 오픈 소스로 공개된다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김정아 객원기자 기자로 14년, 자본시장에서 18년 일했습니다. 글로벌 기업과 자본시장을 주시하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production Expanded sovereign standards with the EBU help European broadcasters protect editorial independence and cultural identity, while NVIDIA-accelerated Adobe Frame.io workflows help studios find content faster across massive content libraries. October 19, 2026 by Richard Kerris 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! At a creative industry event that took place today in Berlin — hosted in collaboration with Adobe , Bertelsmann , NVIDIA and UFA — the latest advancements in intelligent media were on display. Key to the news: the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) is collaborating with NVIDIA to expand its sovereign framework with cloud, open models and integration partners, while Adobe Frame.io is accelerating video agent search capabilities with NVIDIA GPUs, helping German TV and film producer UFA find the right moments faster. Read more about both announcements below. Sovereign Clouds and Open Models Built for European Broadcasters The EBU and NVIDIA are expanding the sovereign standards they introduced last year for European public service media. The initiative now brings in sovereign cloud providers, open model developers and systems integrators to define how broadcasters can deploy agents while keeping control of their data, infrastructure, models and security. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements The EBU is the world’s leading alliance of public service media, with over 115 member organizations in more than 55 countries reaching over 1 billion people. As agents move into newsrooms, production and audience services, those broadcasters need a foundation that protects editorial independence, data sovereignty and national resilience. items.fullText: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW Plus, stream ‘Enshrouded’ 1.0 and ‘Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’ alongside 10 new games this week. October 15, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Dial in the next gaming session this GFN Thursday. New NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls give GeForce NOW members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. Then, step into the Shroud as Keen Games’ Enshrouded leaves early access with its 1.0 release, or let the bolts fly in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 . Both are streaming on GeForce NOW at launch. With 10 new games joining the cloud this week, members can put the new controls to work in supported titles and keep playing across supported devices without downloads, installs or expensive hardware upgrades. Fine-Tune the Cloud With DLSS 4.5 Controls More control, more cloud power. NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls are now available on GeForce NOW, giving members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. DLSS Super Resolution sharpens image quality, while Dynamic Multi Frame Generation delivers lower latency and reduces stutter for smoother streaming, and Ray Reconstruction enhances ray-traced visuals. In addition, Ultimate members streaming on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs benefit from the maximum available options, including Dynamic Multi Frame Generation up to 4X. From James Bond’s globe-trotting missions in 007 First Light — now with path tracing support — to CONTROL Resonant ’s reality-bending Manhattan and the shadowy scares of Resident Evil Requiem , the controls help fine-tune supported games for image quality, responsiveness or a preferred balance between the two. These new settings are available in the GeForce NOW app under settings, for Windows, macOS, Chrome OS and Steam OS platforms. Members can read here for more details

items.fullText: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW Plus, discover 10 new games streaming from the cloud this week. October 8, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Gears of War: E-Day leads the charge on GeForce NOW this week, bringing Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago’s first fight against the Locust Horde to the cloud with GeForce RTX-powered performance. A new way to join the action is also coming: Fire TV users will soon be able to purchase GeForce NOW memberships directly through Amazon , creating a more seamless path from device setup to gameplay. Keep an eye out for availability in the coming weeks. There’s more in store this GFN Thursday, with the cloud serving up 10 games, including seven new releases. Emergence Day Is Here Gears of War: E-Day is now streaming on GeForce NOW following its global release on Tuesday, Oct. 6. Set 14 years before the original Gears of War , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day. The series’ brutal combat, desperate survival and larger-than-life action return with a new origin story for the legendary partnership. Ultimate members can take on the Horde with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, plus technologies including NVIDIA DLSS and NVIDIA Reflex . From campaign missions to cooperative and competitive modes, GeForce NOW keeps the fight ready across low-power laptops, Macs, mobile devices, handhelds, Firefox and other browsers, and more — no massive downloads or expensive gaming rig required. New on the Cloud Menu Members can look forward to the following games joining the GeForce NOW library this week: Gears of War: E-Day (New release on Steam and Xbox , Oct. 6), available on Game Pass STAR WARS: Galactic Racer (New release on Steam , Oct. 6) Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival (New release on Steam , Oct. 8) Forever Ago (New release on Steam , Oct. 8) Orde
